rubrics.justification: Provides a plausible Day-5 blastocyst assessment with reasonable Gardner-style grading, but includes some potentially over-interpreted details (e.g., precise ICM location, polar body/extruded fragment, zona thinning) that may not be confidently discernible from a single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, smoking, prior IVF outcomes, endometrial thickness, and sperm data with embryo quality and prognosis.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a structured prognosis framework; minor issues include somewhat speculative quantitative adjustments and slight inconsistency between implantation and clinical pregnancy ranges.

Mostly evidence-aligned on SET, smoking cessation, and general prognosis, but recommendations such as routine ERA, estradiol supplementation due to low BMI, and relatively early PGT-A advocacy in a 28-year-old are more debatable and not strongly guideline-driven.
Gives clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, though some recommendations are broader than necessary and a few are not tightly tailored to standard indications.
